name: @xeplr/workflow
description: Workflows over @xeplr/actions — steps that bind inputs to earlier outputs, branch on conditions, fan out over lists and wait for a person or a job. registerWorkflow() mounts it into a host Express app, or it runs on its own.

scripts.db:create: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate create-db --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION
scripts.migrate:up: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate up --dir ./migrations --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION
scripts.migrate:status: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate status --dir ./migrations --connectionName api --connection-env WORKFLOW_CONNECTION

author: xeplr
